p: Played by Robert Downey Jr., revealed at San Diego Comic-Con in July 2024.

n: Kang was set up, then dropped
p: Marvel pivoted the saga's big bad from Kang to Doom. How the story bridges that is still unknown.
Thunderbolts* (2025) reveals its team to the world as the New Avengers.
The second post-credits scene of VisionQuest's finale (Nov 10, 2026) is a direct Doomsday setup. Details are spoiler-hidden on the News page.
Spider-Man: Brand New Day (July 31, 2026) takes place before Doomsday, and Yelena appears in it.
The September 2026 re-release of Endgame added footage and an end tag set in the Doomsday story.
